title: Chapter 175 The Three Elders Gather
content:
Chapter 175 The Three Elders Gather

Inside the City Lord's Mansion.

Lu Xue chatted with Lu Daosheng for a few words and then left.

Lying on the armchair, Lu Daosheng looked at the sky and began to wander.

Many, many years have passed since he got the system.

The people and things around him have also undergone earth-shaking changes.

And he has also experienced a lot of things.

Fortunately, when he came to this point, the people around him are still there.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng smiled, then stood up, patted his butt, and walked outside.

......

Inner City of Deserted City.

At the entrance of a simple mansion.

This is the Li family, one of the three super families in Deserted City.

Even the two guards at the door have reached the level of Godly Lord.

At this time, an old man in coarse linen clothes walked towards him slowly. Although he was very slow, he was extremely steady.

Seeing the old man, the two guards suddenly looked solemn.

"Quick, go and inform the head of the family!"

Then, a guard rushed into the house.

The other guard who stayed behind trotted to the old man.

"Old Zhang, you are here again."

The guard smiled awkwardly and prepared to help the old man.

The old man was the ancestor of the Zhang family.

Old Zhang chuckled and said, "Why, are you not welcome?"

Hearing this, the guard was immediately frightened and broke out in a cold sweat, and was about to kneel down.

Seeing this, Old Zhang just raised his hand, and the guard couldn't kneel down at all.

"Okay, look how scared you are."

Old Zhang laughed.

Hearing this, the guard wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and whispered, "Old Zhang, this is not a joke."

If the head of the family knew about it, his head would be moved.

At this time, Old Zhang had already walked towards the Li family mansion on his own.

The road was familiar, as if he had come to his own home.

Seeing this, the guards hurriedly followed closely behind him, not daring to say a word.

"Junior Li Gengnian, meet Senior Zhang."

The head of the Li family, Li Gengnian, personally led people to greet Senior Zhang.

So many years have passed, and the head of the Zhang family has changed several times, but the head of the Li family is still Li Gengnian. It can be imagined that Li Gengnian is powerful.

When he saw Li Gengnian, Senior Zhang did not say much, but just said in a light voice: "Gengnian, you do your thing, I'll find Old Li."

Then, Senior Zhang continued to go deep into the Li family mansion.

At the original place, Li Gengnian looked at Senior Zhang respectfully until he could no longer see his figure, and then he retracted his gaze.

"Master, why has Senior Zhang come so frequently recently?"

At this time, the eldest elder of the Li family asked with some confusion.

Hearing this, the faces of the others were also puzzled.

In the past few years, the ancestors of the Zhang family did come to visit their Li family, but definitely not so frequently.

In the past month, the ancestors of the Zhang family have come to their Li family twenty times.

I wish I could come once a day.

And the Liu family is basically the same.

Why is this?

"Have you forgotten what the city lord said to our ancestors?"

At this time, Li Gengnian said in a calm voice.

Hearing this, everyone began to recall.

"Let's drink together when we are free?"

Another elder murmured to himself.

Suddenly, everyone reacted.

"Master, what do you mean?"

Li Gengnian smiled and said, "Do you think that the words of a person like the city lord would be casual?"

"I think the city lord's meaning should be to make our three major families more united."

"So, the city lord brought the ancestors of our three major families together in the name of drinking."

Hearing the analysis of the master Li Gengnian, some people nodded in understanding.

Some people frowned even more deeply.

"Master, haven't the three families always been united?"

"And the ancestors don't care about things anymore. It seems that there is no point in calling them three."

The one who said this was a young elder of the Li family.

As soon as this was said, everyone glared at the young elder.

"Humph, you guy, how long have you been an elder? How dare you question the master of the family."

"Come on, drag him away."

Then, two guards with strong auras suddenly appeared on the scene.

Seeing this scene, the young elder's face turned pale.

"Master, don't do it, Master, I was wrong!"

At this time, Li Gengnian stretched out his hand and signaled the two guards to withdraw.

"What you said makes sense."

"But what you don't know is that our three families are only united on the surface. In fact, there is a lot of chaos below."

The three major families have huge power in the deserted city. Except for the direct forces of the city lord's mansion, there is basically no opponent.

Therefore, many small groups in Huangcheng would choose to rely on the three major families.

Now, those small groups have become increasingly powerful under the protection of the three major families, and many groups have even begun to confront each other.

In response, the three major families did not respond.

"As for the ancestors not taking care of things."

Li Gengnian suddenly showed a complicated look, "You are, if the ancestors want to take care of things, can they still take care of things?"

Hearing this, everyone suddenly realized.

Yes, the ancestors are indeed retired now, but if they want to take care of things, no one in the family will refuse.

He dared not refuse either.

After all, that is his ancestor.

So, are the ancestors going to come back?

Thinking of this, everyone suddenly felt a lot of thoughts.

At the same time, deep in the Li family.

In a bamboo forest.

Two elderly men with crane hair and baby faces were sitting opposite each other.

"Old Li, how are you doing recently?"

Mr. Zhang spoke first, with a serious expression.

Upon hearing this, Old Li nodded heavily.

"I will naturally not relax my guard against such things."

Seeing this, Mr. Zhang nodded.

"This time, we must not be embarrassed anymore. If we are embarrassed anymore, we will have no place to put our old face."

Hearing this, Old Li snorted coldly: "For this victory, I have not drunk a month."

Last time, the three of them were poured down by Lu Daosheng one after another, and since then, they have been ridiculed by Lu Daosheng for a long time.

Even whenever I think of that incident, I feel a little unwilling to accept it.

Three old men couldn't even drink one.

I'm afraid of embarrassing when I say it.

So, this time the three of them decided to join forces to fight against Lu Daosheng.

"By the way, where is Lao Liu?"

Lao Zhang asked.

Old Li stroked his beard and said in a low voice: "It should be coming soon."

Sure enough, not long after, a figure slowly walked from a distance.

It just seems that the pace is very frivolous.

And at this time, a strong smell of wine came from the air.

Suddenly, the two of them looked ugly.

"Old Liu, don't you say you can't drink during this period?!"

......

The second day.

After a long night, the ancestors of the Liu family finally woke up from their sleep.

As soon as I saw it, I saw two old faces that were quite complaining.

"Well, you're all here."

Old Liu was a little embarrassed.

"Hmph, you still know how to wake up, why don't you sleep to death?"

Old Li snorted coldly.

Old Zhang, who was standing beside him, shook his head slightly, "I knew you were unreliable."

Seeing the two of them doing this, Old Liu felt a little ashamed and said, "When will the City Lord come?"

"I've come."

As soon as he finished speaking, a figure suddenly appeared not far away.
